capabilities: Apply view modes via folder rules
Match files with regex patterns to set view modes
Set view mode per note through a frontmatter key
Lock files or folders to a view mode from the context menu
Show lock icons in File Explorer and Notebook Navigator
disambiguation: Not a manual view switcher or a display of the current view; it sets view modes automatically based on rules.
extras: Beta builds are distributed via BRAT; the README warns that Obsidian's pre-release handling may not automatically switch testers back to stable releases.
motivation: The author cites the Obsidian community's need for better view mode control.
problem: Obsidian's view mode must be switched manually per note, so different kinds of notes (templates, daily notes, finished docs) don't open in the right mode by default.

relations.evidence: Integrated with Notebook Navigator by Johan Sanneblad

summary: Rule-based plugin that automatically sets each note's view mode (Reading, Live Preview, Source) from folder, regex, tag, or frontmatter rules.
